## Checklist

- [ ] Based on the latest `main`, and does one thing (or bundles small changes a maintainer agreed to)
- [ ] Title `<type>: <summary>` in English, with no AI attribution (CI adds the version)
- [ ] Everything in English; if one README changed, the other matches
- [ ] All UI text in the locale files, in both languages
- [ ] No Google services or public CDNs; new dependencies work in mainland China
- [ ] No name of the board game this is based on; words and art are original
- [ ] Unrevealed card colors go to captains only (if this touches state broadcasts)
- [ ] No passwords, keys or tokens
- [ ] Nothing about how the project's own servers are run
- [ ] UI changes checked at phone width
